title: Allowance for a Late Provisional Credit, Paystride Visa Payroll Card Premier and Elite
content:
A resolved lost or stolen card claim on the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Premier or Elite plan is due a service allowance. It follows the business days from the claim's notice date to the posting date of its provisional credit. Business days are Monday through Friday excluding Federal Reserve holidays, counted from the day after the earlier date through the later one.

| Business days from notice date to provisional credit | Allowance due |
|---|---|
| more than 8 | 10.00 |
| more than 5 and not more than 8 | 5.00 |
| not more than 5 | nothing |

*Hypothetical cases:* a provisional credit posted 4 business days after the notice earns nothing, one posted 7 business days after earns 5.00, and one posted 11 business days after earns 10.00.
